title: Grid Rush
short_description: Neon hover-circuit racer — drift the prism rails, snag Data Orbs, deploy original tech gadgets, and outrun AI crews across five cyber arenas.
description: Grid Rush is a premium browser hover-kart racer. Pilot original chassis (Prism Sled, Volt Runner, Glass Phantom, Mag-Drill, Echo Wedge, Nova Disc) on luminous ribbon tracks. Grab Data Orbs for tech gadgets that are NOT Mario Kart clones — Pulse Mines, Phase Skate, Volt Lash, Gravity Wells, Mirror Fog, Overclock, EMP Bloom, Data Siphon, Warp Anchor, Static Veil. Drift for turbine charge, rubber-band AI rivals, three-lap circuits, standings HUD, and synthwave presentation. Standalone game — not Neon Veil.
controls_keyboard: A/D or ←/→ steer · W throttle · S brake · SPACE drift · E / LMB use item · SHIFT burst · Esc pause
art_direction: Premium synthwave hover-circuit key art: prism sleds on glowing magenta/cyan rails over a night megacity, Data Orb crates, drift sparks, cinematic browser-game poster.
